title: Three lists, one probe
notes: Twelve points in three groups. k-means settles in 2 rounds: c1 (2, 2.5), c2 (7.75, 2.5), c3 (4.5, 8.25), four points each. The query (7, 3) is deep inside c2's cell, so searching only list c2 finds F, G and E: exact, after 7 distance computations against brute force's 12.
